```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
titanic = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))

# Plot 1: Count plot of survivors by class
sns.countplot(ax=axes[0], data=titanic, x='class', hue='survived', palette='viridis')
axes[0].set_title('Survival Count by Class')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Number of Passengers')
axes[0].legend(title='Survived', loc='upper right', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Plot 2: Age distribution of passengers who survived vs those who did not
sns.histplot(ax=axes[1], data=titanic, x='age', hue='survived', multiple='stack', palette='viridis', bins=30)
axes[1].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Age')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Number of Passengers')
axes[1].legend(title='Survived', loc='upper right', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
